scope: Independent checks and declared-assumption reconstructions; no author measurements
snr_interpretation_note: 35 dB is the paper value. 70 dB is only a sensitivity hypothesis: using 10^(-35/10) for an amplitude ratio corresponds to 70 dB power SNR. It is not attributed to the authors.

acceptance.theory: STD ratios within 8%; fitted time exponent within 0.05 of -1.5
acceptance.paper_figures: Original conditions and statistical definitions required; closeness under assumed parameters does not certify reproduction
acceptance.resolution: Report single-window discrimination and independent-repeat uncertainty separately; never treat overlapping outputs as independent
